title: Confluence
summary: Reviewed architecture, requirements, decisions, runbooks, and explanations.

sections.label: Useful automation
items: Draft documentation from accepted changes and linked evidence.
Detect conflicts or stale references between documents and implementation.
Prepare architecture decision material with alternatives and unresolved constraints.
Maintain source anchors, owner, review status, and last verification date.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Generated prose becomes reviewed project knowledge through the normal ownership process. A summary is a navigation aid; its citations must lead back to underlying evidence.

catalog.applicability: Use this Confluence example when reviewed decisions, requirements, runbooks and explanations live in Confluence and you want automation to draft or check documentation from accepted changes. Generated prose becomes project knowledge only through the normal ownership process.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
